text: The universal cover $\widetilde{SL_2(\mathbb{R})}$ of $SL_2(\mathbb{R})$ is a matrix Lie group.
explanation: False: the chapter singles out $\widetilde{SL_2(\mathbb{R})}$ as a Lie group that is NOT a matrix group — it admits no faithful finite-dimensional representation. So although it is a genuine simply connected Lie group, it cannot be realized as a closed subgroup of any $GL_n$.
